teams.purpose: Recon flightcrew's terrain, history and doctrine; verify harness claims; cut candidate epic missions
Certified research team: turn the recon and the genesis sources into records for the pilot, contested and verified, run past the commander before landing
Critique the pilot's cockpit work of 2026-09-18 and the approved plan from two angles: fit with the cockpit's purpose and corpus; bulk that can be trimmed without losing function
First agent team: cockpit cleanup suggestions, official best practices, adversary on both
CLAUDE.md review: official docs on CLAUDE.md, cockpit comb, judge and redraft
Strengthened research team: mine the commander's transcripts and advice into timeless flightdeck topics, distil the first records under the docspec, contested and validated
One-shot doc-reviewer (chat-tools:doc-reviewer, Sonnet) on the records docspec in CLAUDE.md rule 2 and records/README.md

fields.file: team file under a room (cockpit/ or flightcrew/); null for a one-shot subagent outside a team

note: Date, session, mission and room are in each team file's header; access and delivery vary by seat and are in the seat lines.
